sections.text:
Be sure the valve was out of operation and the pressure inside the pipeline 
 connected to the valve must be zero from the two end of the valve.
Lap the disk wear or cracks or change the defect disk.
Change the bearing if it is bad.
تصنيع الآلات للساق أو استبدال العيب.
Replace the pen if it is wear.
Retighten the gland if it is leakage or replace it.
